verdict: 2026-08-03 06:56:31 PDT — The per-(AC, surface) table and lightweight phrase pins are proportionate, consistent with this instruction-only repository, and introduce no unnecessary dependency or parser. I would not ship the shape unchanged, however: retraction review is assigned to a phase that runs before retractions can exist, and the mechanical-story escape hatch contradicts the new every-AC exclusion invariant.

findings.title: Retractions are reviewed before they can exist
findings.claim: Step 6 tells the frame-time design reviewer to critique amendment-log retractions, but step 6 runs before approval while the amendment log can only be created during step 9 implementation. The only explicitly tasked check is therefore temporally incapable of seeing a retraction. The later approach pass is generic and the story explicitly excludes `/review`-side changes, leaving a cross-cutting claim future stories may treat as reviewed when it was not observable.
findings.alternative: Move amendment and retraction inspection to the post-implementation approach pass. Prefer defining the falsification-plan review rubric once in the shared reviewer contract and having both review phases apply it; the frame review handles enumeration, exclusions, and circular oracles, while the approach review additionally evaluates actual amendments and retractions.
findings.win: Eliminates one impossible review path, ensures every retraction is inspected only after it exists, and centralizes the rubric instead of relying on phase-specific prompt duplication.

findings.title: Whole-plan mechanical N/A bypasses the per-AC invariant
findings.claim: The new contract says every AC must carry a three-valued `surfaces excluded` declaration and that silence is not permitted, but the retained whole-plan `N/A — mechanical` escape hatch allows all per-AC declarations to disappear based on a subjective story-level label. That makes the central extent claim conditional and gives future stories a protocol-wide bypass.
findings.alternative: Keep the mechanical exemption for regression/oracle detail if desired, but still enumerate each AC and require its `surfaces excluded` line in one of the three approved forms.
findings.win: Removes one special-case bypass and leaves a single invariant for reviewers and any future presence check: every AC always declares its considered extent.
